test: exact two-sided McNemar test (binomial test on discordant pairs, p = 0.5)
selection_rule: The two configurations with the highest mean test accuracy over their 3 GPU runs (ties: fewer trainable parameters, then fixed configuration order) are compared with an exact two-sided McNemar test on their seed-0 runs (run 1 of every configuration), paired by original MNIST test index. Seeds 1 and 2 are reported separately as a sensitivity check; runs are never pooled. Significance level alpha = 0.05. The rule was fixed before computing the test.
interpretation_note: McNemar tests whether, on these 10,000 test images, the two trained models' error rates differ (H0: discordant pairs split 50/50). A non-significant result means no difference was detected; it does not establish equivalence. The test concerns these two trained models (one seed each), not all possible training runs.
